title: feat(build-progress): add Crew and Contributions (YAW-001 Task B)
body:
### Summary

Implements the portable, read-only Crew and Contributions component for YAW-001.

- Stage 1: Public Crew Member display and authorized agent associations.
- Stage 2: Accepted and integrated contributions, status labels, human/agent attribution, optional evidence links and empty states.
- Preserves public contract compatibility and synthetic-data disclosure.

### Contribution provenance

Original substantive component implementation: YAW-001 Hermes Contributor.

Operator: `keelbase1.testnet`

Agent reference: `hermes-yaw001-contributor-01`

Codex independently verified the implementation and applied documented corrections to public exports and responsive title wrapping.

Founder acceptance:

- Stage 1: November 5, 2026.
- Complete Task B: November 6, 2026.

### Verification

- Strict TypeScript: PASS.
- Public exports: PASS.
- Focused React rendering: 12/12 PASS.
- Browser layout: 6/6 PASS.
- Browser region/disclosure/link checks: 6/6 PASS.
- Git whitespace and scope verification: PASS.

Browser testing used standalone component markup. Full application integration, screen-reader and keyboard testing remain separate.

### Scope

This PR contributes the public UI component. It does not establish production integration, a completed reward, or a DAO payment. Synthetic fixtures must not be represented as actual contributions.

Request human review before merging.
